_comment: Edit this file to change what the UI critic looks at. Routes, references and the round limit live here only.

app._launchNote: If nothing answers at baseUrl, start the server with preview_start {name: launchName} from .claude/launch.json and use its port.

references.name: Watch Duty
references.lookAt: Live incident map with a side list: per-incident status, age, size and containment on one card; icon-coded severity; mobile-first layout; calm map styling with strong markers.

references.name: HOT Tasking Manager
references.lookAt: Volunteer task cards: difficulty, progress bar, contributor count, priority tag; clear filter bar; how a person picks and claims a task.
